build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a falling jar that must touch a ball on a bar
create_dynamic_jar: create an upside down dynamic jar centered at the top of the scene
add_static_bar_with_hole: add two static bars with a configurable hole in the middle for the jar to fall through
update_task_relationships: update the task goal to require the jar touching the ball using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to BALL for the task template
